name: Story — Farbound
html:
We started Farbound with a simple belief: getting off the grid shouldn't mean giving anything up. As long-time overlanders ourselves, we rebuilt the travel trailer from first principles — an all-electric design that's aerodynamic and engineered to go further on less. Whether you're chasing a weekend loop or crossing three states, our trailers are built for comfort, connection, and freedom, so the only thing you have to think about is the road ahead.

name: Material — Fernwood
html:
Materials

Two techniques sit at the center of this collection. The first mills fine glass powder onto sheets of glass with a printmaker's silk screen, building a surface that holds light the way paper holds ink — soft, textured, and never quite the same twice.

The second slumps sheet glass over hand-built molds, so every panel keeps a trace of the mold it was shaped on.

name: About — Fernwood
html:
Fernwood is a design studio built on collaboration between artisans, materials, and the rooms our work ends up in

Working together, we're committed to redefining the familiar — bringing considered materials, detail-oriented design, and real adaptability to furniture and lighting for every kind of room.

Our founders, Marguerite Solis and Owen Vachal, are longtime collaborators whose path into business began with a shared goal: build well-made objects that pair meticulous, made-to-order craftsmanship with manufacturing that can actually scale. Since founding Fernwood in 2017, that same systems-based approach has shaped nearly everything in the catalog.

name: FAQ — Fernwood
html:
Frequently Asked Questions

With proper care, our pieces are built to last. Here's what to know before you order, plus how to keep everything looking right for years after.

Have a question about your order? Write to hello@fernwoodstudio.com.

  • Products
  • Ordering
  • Shipping
  • Returns
  • Use & Care
  • Accounts

What materials do you work with?

As a rule, we only work with solid materials: brass, steel, glass, and clay. We use manufacturing and decorative techniques that respect each material's natural tendencies rather than fight them.

Brass

All of our brass pieces are unlacquered, so the finish is left to patina naturally with time and handling.

Steel

Steel components are wet-coated for precise color rather than powder-coated, which keeps costs down without sacrificing finish quality.

Glass

Our glass is either hand-blown or slumped over molds, and is usually left with its natural glossy texture intact.

Clay

Ceramic elements are slab-built, hand-thrown, or slip-cast, and either left raw or glazed to highlight the material's texture.

name: Material — Formwright
html:
Four materials, worked honestly

Two hand techniques sit at the center of our glasswork — one presses finely milled color into molten glass with tools borrowed from printmaking, the other slumps sheet glass over shaped molds until it settles into form. Everything else in the catalog follows the same instinct: use solid materials, and let each one behave the way it wants to.

  • Brass

    Every brass piece leaves the shop unlacquered, so it earns a genuine patina over years of use.

  • Steel

    Steel fixtures are wet-coated for precise, lasting color — a more considered alternative to powder-coating.

  • Glass

    Our glass is hand-blown or slumped over molds, and usually left with its natural sheen intact.

  • Clay

    Ceramic components are slab-built, hand-thrown, or slip-cast, often left raw to show the material's texture.

name: Philosophy — Winslow
html:
Our Philosophy

Our Vision

There is no better place to mark a milestone than around a table set with care. Our vision is to bring quiet craftsmanship to everyday dining, creating moments worth slowing down for.

Our Mission

Winslow brings considered design to kitchens and dining rooms everywhere. Through hand-finished glazes and honest materials, we help hosts and cooks turn an ordinary meal into something worth remembering.

name: Craft — Winslow
html:
Made by hand, one glaze at a time

Machine-made dinnerware looks the same from the first piece to the millionth. Ours does not, and that is the point.

Every Winslow piece is thrown, trimmed and dipped by a small studio team in small batches. The glazes are mixed from raw minerals and tested for months before a single finish is approved, which is why no two plates in a set are ever quite identical.

name: Story — Winslow
html:
Our Story

Founded as part of the Aldergate family of home and tableware brands, Winslow has always been driven by a simple belief: that the objects we set on a table shape how people feel when they gather around it.

Every glaze is mixed and tested by hand in our small coastal studio, and every finish carries the same restless attention to color and texture that inspired our very first collection.
